title: The Safehouse of Tashkent
author: Rosalind Kavanagh
blurb: Juniper Kavanagh, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
